Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_Maximum: Highest aim-time multiplier, reached after the configured number of tiles beyond effective-sight range. A weapon whose physical range ends sooner receives a smaller penalty. Default: 4.0.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_CurveEx: Controls how quickly extra aim time ramps up beyond effective-sight range. Higher values keep the increase gentler near sight range and steeper near the full-penalty distance. Default: 1.5.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_FullPen: Number of tiles beyond effective-sight range required to reach the maximum aim-time multiplier. Weapons whose physical range ends before this distance never reach the maximum. Default: 10.
